verdict.rationale: GrowthBook documents environments such as dev, staging and production that let you enable or disable feature flags independently (docs-3). It also offers SDK Connection Endpoints that give read-only access to a subset of flag data (docs-20), though the pack never explicitly says these are scoped per environment, and custom environments beyond the defaults are a higher-tier pricing feature (docs-16). Missing for 10: explicit evidence that SDK keys/connections are scoped per environment, clarity on which environments come without the paid tier, and independent or hands-on corroboration of multi-environment workflows.
